title: Blink-182 bandmate had intelligence community ties
summary: Jay Anderson tells of Blink-182 bandmate had intelligence community ties, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> what? So then another member of Blink 182 had family members in the in the intelligence community,

plain: A man named Jay Anderson, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, passed on something about the rock band Blink-182, whose member Tom DeLonge he cites. Anderson says that another member of the band had family members in the intelligence community, meaning the government's spy agencies. He tells it because, if true, it would tie the band to the secret world it has been linked with.
